question:
Select the letter-group which has the same relation to the third letter-group as the second letter-group is to the first letter-group.

RVSM : PUSO :: SHIT : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf7e3ee0123fd1e31878ed12e67fbb13bf5a41852be7b1dafc48a587766df1e5.png] 

The logic followed is:

For, **"RVSM : PUSO**":

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c9976fd34e5aea5273093c4a8f1ccf39318fe3b13ead8f3c0da9558551076d.png] 

Now for **"SHIT : ?":**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/824e6c78ed3270649cb453d14c53dc4e1a16bd3628f1e093742d4949326b739b.png] 

As the relationship obtained is **"SHIT : QGIV".**

Hence, the correct answer is **"QGIV".**
